input.rationale: There is no audit, inspection or usage-verification right exercisable by Garman against Sparkling anywhere in the Agreement, and no Garman access to our systems. The only examination right runs in our favour (escrowed Codes), so there is nothing to redline.

input.quote: Sparkling may terminate this Agreement at any time upon ninety (90) calendar days written notice to Garman.
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalties, shortfall charges or early-termination fees are payable by Sparkling; on termination for Garman's default Garman must refund fees for services not yet rendered. This matches our preferred position.
